parameters.name: moonray.maxMeshLights
parameters.description: how many MeshLight objects are created at most for materials with emissionSampling, for a renderer which does not set its parameter of the same name

parameters.name: pixelSamples
parameters.description: samples per pixel; MoonRay samples an NxN grid, so the value is rounded up to the next perfect square

parameters.name: moonray.lightSamples
parameters.description: MoonRay light_samples: per-axis count of light samples per light at each hit (N*N samples); MoonRay's own default is 2

parameters.name: moonray.bsdfSamples
parameters.description: MoonRay bsdf_samples: per-axis count of BSDF samples per lobe at each hit (N*N samples); MoonRay's own default is 2

parameters.name: moonray.maxMeshLights
parameters.description: how many MeshLight objects are created at most for materials with emissionSampling; the emitters with the most power get them, the others emit as surfaces only; without it the device parameter of the same name counts

parameters.name: moonray.maxMeshLightTriangles
parameters.description: how many triangles the meshes of the lights for materials with emissionSampling may have together, both sides and all instances counted; MoonRay rebuilds a mesh light for every edit of it, in about a second per 250000 triangles

parameters.name: maxBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of bounces of a path after the camera hit, of any kind (MoonRay max_depth)

parameters.name: maxDiffuseBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of diffuse bounces (MoonRay max_diffuse_depth)

parameters.name: maxGlossyBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of glossy bounces (MoonRay max_glossy_depth; with maxTransmissionBounce also max_mirror_depth)

parameters.name: maxTransmissionBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of transmission bounces through clear refractive surfaces (MoonRay max_mirror_depth = max of this and maxGlossyBounce)

parameters.name: maxVolumeBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of volume scattering bounces after the first scattering event (MoonRay max_volume_depth - 1)

parameters.name: maxTransparencyBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of cutout (presence) surfaces a path passes through (MoonRay max_presence_depth)

parameters.name: clampDirect
parameters.description: limit for the contribution of a direct lighting sample at the camera hit, 0 for none; only effective when it is not above clampIndirect (MoonRay sample_clamping_depth 0)

parameters.name: clampIndirect
parameters.description: limit for the contribution of a lighting sample after the first bounce, 0 for none (MoonRay sample_clamping_value)

parameters.name: emissionSampling
parameters.description: sample the emission of the material with lights as well: a MeshLight for each of these sides of every instance of a triangle geometry that has the material, up to moonray.maxMeshLights; the surface itself then only emits for camera and mirror rays

objects.name: rdla
objects.description: a MoonRay shading network given as RDL2 ASCII (rdla) text

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: optional object name

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: rdla (Lua) fragment that creates one Material and the maps it uses; a string attribute whose value equals the name of an image2D sampler parameter of this material refers to that sampler's image

parameters.name: materialName
parameters.description: name of the root Material object created by the fragment

parameters.name: emissionSampling
parameters.description: sample the emission of the material with lights as well: a MeshLight for each of these sides of every instance of a triangle geometry that has the material, up to moonray.maxMeshLights; the surface itself then only emits for camera and mirror rays

parameters.name: emissionColor
parameters.description: with emissionSampling: the radiance the lights emit, multiplied with emissionMap when that is set

parameters.name: emissionMap
parameters.description: with emissionSampling: name of a Map object of the fragment the radiance of the lights is multiplied with

parameters.name: sampledMaterialName
parameters.description: with emissionSampling: name of the root Material of the fragment which the surface is shaded with while lights sample its emission; it has to emit for camera and mirror rays only

parameters.name: visibility.camera
parameters.description: the instance is visible to camera (primary) rays

parameters.name: visibility.diffuse
parameters.description: the instance is visible to diffuse reflection rays

parameters.name: visibility.glossy
parameters.description: the instance is visible to glossy/specular reflection rays

parameters.name: visibility.transmission
parameters.description: the instance is visible to transmission (refraction) rays

parameters.name: visibility.volumeScatter
parameters.description: the instance is visible to volume scattering rays

parameters.name: visibility.shadow
parameters.description: the instance casts shadows (is visible to shadow rays)

parameters.name: objectRandom
parameters.description: a random number of the object, exported as the per-instance primitive attribute anari_object_random (float) for shading networks to read; the instance's color and id are exported as anari_object_color (rgb) and anari_object_index (float)

parameters.name: falloff.distance
parameters.description: distances from the point of the light which emits, increasing: the emission is multiplied with falloff.color at these distances, linear in between and constant before the first and after the last (a MoonRay ColorRampLightFilter)

parameters.name: falloff.color
parameters.description: what the emission of the light is multiplied with at the distances of falloff.distance
